Use case: scientific-educational, precise-object-edit. Produce a continuous pedagogical anatomy painting for a Kansei clinical ultrasound/anatomy toggle. IMAGE 1 is the clinician's annotated GEOMETRY GUIDE; IMAGE 2 is the corresponding clean ultrasound and determines the REAL tissue shapes. IMAGE 3 is the APPROVED MATERIAL STYLE ONLY. Do not transfer its anatomy, labels, two-panel layout or pathology.

Paint the scan field only, without machine interface, all words, all annotation colors, arrows, guide lines, black redaction boxes or labels. Enlarge that entire scan field into one rectangular illustration. Use the exact source view and orientation; don't redesign it as a generic hip drawing. Every anatomical boundary from Image 1 must be faithfully followed. Do not add unmarked anatomy or lesions. Entire source scan field painted continuously, no grayscale islands, no collage or warped texture tiles. Fine irregular warm tan trabecular bone, ivory fine cortex, softly fading to dark with depth; explanatory bone interior. Deep field fades to black, never unpainted ultrasound.

Match the approved style EXACTLY: organically curving fine brick-red muscle fascicles with delicate ivory septa; modest golden lobular superficial fat; fine matte ivory and taupe collagen; small irregular tan bone trabeculae, not giant honeycomb; dark/navy only where supported. Especially FASCIA: reproduce the source's branching, oblique pale fascial laminae and fine intramuscular connective tissue, separating distinct muscle bellies and groups of fascicles. Broad fascial sheets must remain fine, irregular, naturally layered, not turn into tendons or thick white ropes. No artificial fat pockets between all muscles. All muscle types use the same established red material; anatomical separation comes from real pale fascia and fiber direction, not different random colors. Treat guide colors only as boundaries, never as a visible color key.
Capsule: subdued gray-ivory/taupe heterogeneously fibrous capsular/recess region. Retain its real thickness and contour. Do not invent large blue fluid, active red synovitis or pristine thick blue cartilage. This is explanatory art, not a diagnostic enhancement.
Output ONLY one detailed matte continuous painting, no text, no watermark, no ruler, no legend.
